title: Quotation completeness and arithmetic
content: Required quotation fields must be present and declared totals must match deterministic calculations within the configured tolerance.

title: Discount approval authority
content: Discounts above ten percent require review by an authorised human. This fixture never records or grants that approval.

title: Restricted-party screening fixture
content: This synthetic fixture demonstrates exact-match routing only. It is not a current restricted-party source and cannot provide sanctions clearance.

title: Foreign-trade and export authorisation fixture
content: This synthetic rule demonstrates a missing-document block. It is not legal advice, authoritative country data, or export clearance.

title: Batch-pure delivery requirement fixture
content: This synthetic rule demonstrates routing when supplier confirmation is absent. It is not supplier evidence or product certification.

title: RIF governed reasoning contract
content: Reasoning must separate facts, assumptions, constraints, contradictions and uncertainty; cite approved evidence; calibrate confidence; abstain or route to human review when material evidence is insufficient; and never own the release decision.
